occasion: Mid-Autumn Festival, 2026-09-25. 20 觀 is the ruling hexagram of the 秋分 month in the app's qi calendar, and 觀 is to look, as at the moon. Version B: the moon rises behind the lines, no labels.

meaning.text:
The power is
in the pause.

question.text:
Who are you
watching it with?

caption.text: Happy Mid-Autumn. Hexagram 20, Contemplation (觀), means to look, as everyone looks at the moon tonight. Its Judgment is the moment before the offering: hands washed, nothing given yet.

lesson.text:
Look like a guest,
not an inspector.
lesson.source: commentary/en/20.json#lines[3].synthesis: the person who observes with the courtesy of a visitor learns more than the one who observes with the authority of an inspector

linkedin.text: Hexagram 20, Contemplation (觀), means to look. Its fourth line says the person who looks with a guest's courtesy learns more than the one who looks with an inspector's authority.
